DETAIL: [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:sparql[1] assignment-coverage constraint: The constraint claims to enforce assignment for every person on board but only compares personOnBoard with a count of distinct persons found in qualifying reified assignment statements. It never identifies the actual persons on board, so the count can be satisfied by different or unrelated persons while an onboard person lacks assigned thermal-protection equipment. Required change: Bind the actual persons-on-board manifest and require each such person to have a qualifying assignedThermalProtection value, rather than relying on an aggregate count. | [OWNERSHIP_PATH] MainShape/sh:sparql[1] assignment-coverage constraint, '?person ?shipMembershipPath $this': The person-to-ship relationship uses an unconstrained variable predicate and assumes the reverse direction from person to ship. This can match arbitrary predicates and does not establish that the matched persons are members of the ship's persons-on-board manifest. Required change: Use the authoritative manifest ownership/path relationship and direction for persons on board, then evaluate assigned thermal protection for those persons.
